odette.overview: Odette brings clothing and accessories together in a women's fashion store, with dresses, co-ord sets, Indian wear, bags, footwear and jewellery in its range. Its design approach combines French influences with Indian craftsmanship, giving shoppers a mix of everyday outfits and occasion pieces. Customers can shop online or visit its physical stores across India. For franchise partners, the published company-operated format covers day-to-day store execution, merchandising and brand standards, with support for opening, training and marketing.
highlights: A women's assortment spanning Western and Indian clothing, jewellery, bags, footwear and accessories.
The brand describes its design approach as French inspired, with Indian craftsmanship and manufacturing.
An online shop is complemented by physical retail stores across India.
Its published FICO format places store operation and merchandising with the company.

original-burger-co.overview: Original Burger Co centres its menu on smash burgers, using patties pressed onto the cooking surface to develop a caramelised crust. The brand describes a hands-on preparation style, with hand-pressed patties, toasted buns and sauces made in-house. Its burger-led offering is accompanied by sides and drinks in a casual restaurant setting. Part of Beamer Brands, the business has roots in Bengaluru, and its official website also lists Chennai and Hyderabad among its Indian locations.
highlights: Specialises in smash burgers with a seared, caramelised patty surface.
The brand describes hand-pressed patties, toasted buns and sauces made in-house.
The official site lists Bengaluru, Chennai and Hyderabad among its Indian locations.
A Beamer Brands concept with a menu extending to sides and drinks.

franco.overview: Franco is a Bengaluru-based menswear label with a wardrobe built around shirts, T-shirts, sweatshirts, jackets, trousers and shorts. Its collection mixes printed cotton-jersey pieces with solid trousers and outerwear, offering options for relaxed dressing and more put-together everyday looks. The range gives shoppers room to build outfits around colour, print and layering. An online shop presents new arrivals alongside best sellers, while a dedicated menswear retail setting lets customers explore that contemporary clothing selection in person.
highlights: A dedicated men's assortment covering shirts, T-shirts, sweatshirts, jackets, trousers and shorts.
Printed cotton-jersey pieces sit alongside solid trousers and outerwear in the current catalogue.
An online store with separate new-arrival and best-seller selections.
A Bengaluru-based contemporary fashion identity, supported by the supplied clothing-store photography.

biggies-burger.overview: Biggies Burger is an Indian burger brand that puts grilled patties at the centre of its menu. Chicken and lamb burgers sit alongside vegetarian choices, with flavours such as tandoori, peri-peri and makhani bringing variety to the range. The menu also extends to grilled wings, wraps, fries, shakes and desserts, giving customers options beyond a single burger. Founded in 2011, the brand began franchising in 2016 and has developed a restaurant network around this burger-led format.
highlights: A grilled-burger focus, including chicken and lamb options.
Menu flavours include tandoori, peri-peri and makhani, with vegetarian choices also available.
The wider range includes grilled wings, wraps, fries, shakes and desserts.
The brand dates its beginnings to 2011 and its first franchise programme to 2016.

bigguys.overview: Bigguys is a chicken-led restaurant brand from Beamer Brands, with a focus on flavoured fried chicken and Korean-style options. Its featured range also includes grilled chicken legs, burgers and chicken-tender salad, giving customers several ways to order beyond a bucket of chicken. The brand developed from a delivery-focused operation into dine-in restaurants. Its official store directory includes Bengaluru, Chennai and Hyderabad, alongside locations in Odisha and Andhra Pradesh, reflecting a footprint across several Indian markets.
highlights: A flavoured fried-chicken concept with Korean-style chicken positioning.
Featured products extend to grilled chicken legs, chicken burgers and a chicken-tender salad.
The business describes a delivery-first start followed by dine-in restaurants.
The official directory lists locations in Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad and several eastern and southern Indian cities.

brand-avenue.overview: Brand Avenue is a Bengaluru-based chain of multibrand factory outlets offering apparel and footwear for men, women and children. Its stores bring casual clothing, formalwear and sportswear together, with a focus on shoppers looking for recognisable brands at accessible prices. The business is part of Wular Lifestyle Private Limited and combines value retail with a modern store setting. Its published partnership offer includes both franchisee-operated and company-operated formats, allowing the operating approach to be discussed alongside the location and store plan.
highlights: Multibrand factory outlets built around value-priced fashion.
Apparel and footwear for men, women and children in one store.
An assortment spanning casual clothing, formalwear and sportswear.
The official partnership page offers both FOFO and FICO operating formats.

lassi-n-cafe.overview: Lassi N Cafe brings together familiar Indian drinks and a broad cafe menu. Sweet, mango and dry fruit lassis sit alongside thick shakes and mojitos, while burgers, sandwiches, pizzas and fried chicken turn a drink stop into a meal. The range includes vegetarian and chicken choices, giving groups several ways to order together. With outlets in Karnataka and a franchise programme that includes setup and marketing support, the brand combines its lassi identity with the variety of a neighbourhood quick-service cafe.
highlights: Lassi choices include sweet, mango, chocolate and dry fruit, alongside milkshakes and mojitos.
The food offer spans burgers, grilled sandwiches, pizzas, fried chicken and snacks.
Vegetarian choices sit alongside chicken dishes in the published Channapatna menu.
The brand describes support with site selection, operations and digital marketing.

fusion-pizza-big-burger.overview: Fusion Pizza & Big Burger Co pairs two familiar quick-service favourites in a single concept. Fusion Pizza brings the pizza side of the offer, while Big Burger Co adds a burger brand developed from the same business. Customers can use the combined app to choose delivery or pickup and customise their orders with available add-ons. Big Burger Co also connects customers to Swiggy and Zomato, giving the paired brands several ordering channels around a straightforward pizza-and-burger proposition.
highlights: The paired concept brings Fusion Pizza and Big Burger Co together under one ordering identity.
Big Burger Co describes itself as a homegrown burger business developed from Fusion Pizza.
The joint app supports delivery, pickup and item add-ons.
Big Burger Co also links to Swiggy and Zomato ordering.

sources.title: Fusion Pizza x Big Burger Co app

kasturi-creations.overview: Kasturi Creations is a women's ethnic wear label launched in 2013 under Style Saga. Its collection moves from kurta and dupatta sets to sarees, dresses and co-ords, with ranges built around Indian weaving and printing traditions such as Jamdani, Ikkat and Ajrakh. Customers can explore everyday and occasion wear online or in the brand's showrooms. A fashion studio offering bespoke styling and stitching adds a personal element, helping shoppers adapt a look to their preferences and the occasion.
highlights: The collection covers dupatta suits, kurta sets, sarees, dresses and co-ord sets.
Regional textile ranges include Jamdani, Ikkat, Sambalpuri, Ajrakh and Banarasi.
The brand offers bespoke styling and stitching through its fashion studio.
Online shopping is complemented by physical showrooms.

10-downing-street.overview: 10 Downing Street brings an English pub atmosphere to Indian cities, combining dining and drinks with a lively calendar of music and themed evenings. The brand began in Hyderabad and developed a recognisable social setting centred on interiors, hospitality and time spent with friends. Its published programme includes karaoke, retro music, rock and Bollywood nights. That mix gives 10D a broad hospitality identity, from an informal meal to an evening out, with a consistent pub concept across its network.
highlights: The concept combines an English pub setting with Indian hospitality.
The experience includes dining, drinks and social occasions.
The brand promotes karaoke, retro, rock and Bollywood themed nights.
It developed from Hyderabad into a pub network across several Indian cities.

freshco-goli-soda.overview: Freshco Goli Soda builds its beverage range around the familiar marble-sealed soda bottle. Its line-up moves from lemon and jeera to fruit-led options such as green mango, red guava and blueberry, bringing variety to a drink associated with Indian street-side refreshment. The franchise proposition centres on producing and distributing beverages locally. Freshco describes support for machinery, raw materials, staff training and marketing, connecting the product's nostalgic appeal with a manufacturing business that supplies shops and other local sales channels.
highlights: The product centres on traditional marble-sealed goli soda bottles.
The published range includes lemon, jeera, ginger, green mango, red guava and berry flavours.
The franchise proposition is beverage manufacturing with local distribution.
The brand describes machinery, training, raw-material and marketing support.

emori.overview: EMORI specialises in lab-grown diamond jewellery, with designs for everyday wear, gifting and milestone occasions. Its collection includes rings, earrings, pendants, necklaces, bracelets and mangalsutras, with gold options such as 14KT and 18KT. The brand pairs its online store with physical locations in Gurugram, Noida and Dwarka, where customers can explore pieces in person. Certified diamonds, hallmarked gold and customisation are central to the offer, giving shoppers several ways to find jewellery that fits their style and budget.
highlights: The brand specialises in lab-grown diamond jewellery for everyday wear and occasions.
EMORI states that its diamonds are IGI/SGL certified and its gold is BIS hallmarked.
Its offer includes rings, earrings, pendants, necklaces, bracelets and mangalsutras.
Online shopping is supported by experience stores in Gurugram, Noida and Dwarka, Delhi.
